question: What does one make in many ways when the mind is one-pointed in meditation?
premises: kurute bahudhā rūpaṃ dhyāna eka gata cetasaḥ
form is made in many ways
the mind is one-pointed in meditation
inference: One makes form in many ways when the mind is one-pointed in meditation.
uncertainties: whether cetasaḥ modifies rūpaṃ or dhyāna
plain_english: One makes form in many ways when the mind is one-pointed in meditation.
